entities.summary: Darren Dietz is a Canadian-Kazakhstani professional ice hockey defenceman currently playing for Dinamo Minsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected in the fifth round, 138th overall, by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2011 NHL Entry Draft.
